phases.blurb: Play the five chapters in order and let the story trophies come to you: all 12 unlock on their own as chapters close and named missions end. While you play, build the habits that pay off later — scan every vehicle you pass, study animals through the binoculars, and meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (see Missables). Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter: 15 manual slots plus one autosave.
phases.title: Phase 1 — Play the story

phases.blurb: Clear the five character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, hunt Bret's unique animal, and do the two partner trophies: shake a 4-star wanted level together, then rob three shops in a row. PowerPyx notes the stranger strands sit outside the 100% checklist, so treat them as their own job.
phases.title: Phase 2 — Side content: strangers, characters, partners

phases.blurb: The long grind: 250 stunts, all 9 activity types, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone-race wins at all 14 locations, 20 race wins, 50 of the 80 challenges, plus the robberies (5 bank vaults, an armored truck, one illegal operation per gang), the jewelry store, Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the Rhinos and the melee drive-by.
phases.title: Phase 3 — Activities & challenges

phases.blurb: Meditate at all 18 spots (the Chapter 1 spot must already be done), complete 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, scan 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas of Leonida, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Most of this is already half done if you explored during the story.
phases.title: Phase 4 — Collectibles & exploration

phases.blurb: Finish the 100% checklist (gold: A Long Road) — about 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges. Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills, spend $100,000 across shops, and mop up the quiet trophies: the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, bowling, the partnership moment, the 500 choices, the second-time charm and the strange event. When the last one pops, the platinum follows.
phases.title: Phase 5 — Economy & cleanup, then the platinum

summary: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at about 200 hours, in a single playthrough. There is no mission replay and no difficulty setting, free roam continues after the story, and cheats disable trophies. Play the five phases in order.
title: Roadmap to the platinum
